reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000380 (the melody read from 000380a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. William James Kirkpatrick's dates (1838–1921) are from our page for the tune THE COMFORTER HAS COME (content/hymns/tunes/the-comforter-has-come.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1891. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1891, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000380a.nwc).
